doc_kind: medical policy (UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange) delegating criteria to InterQual
lines_of_business: Separate Community Plan and Medicare Advantage policies
effective_or_revised: Policy MP.002.29; effective August 1, 2026 (library metadata matches)
sections_in_order: Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews
criteria_location: Coverage Rationale pp.1-3, but the core criteria for blepharoplasty, ectropion, entropion, lesion excision, eyelid reconstruction and ptosis repair are NOT in this document: they are 'InterQual CP: Procedures' (link). Only the carve-outs written in the policy (internal browpexy, lagophthalmos, lid retraction, canthoplasty, floppy eyelid syndrome) have criteria on the page.
procedures_covered: Blepharoplasty 15820-15823, brow ptosis 67900, blepharoptosis 67901-67909 (criteria in InterQual)

logic.top_level: delegation: InterQual for the main procedures; locally written pathways (all-of lists) for lid retraction, thyroid eye disease, canthoplasty, floppy eyelid syndrome

k_of_n.quote: At least one of the following is present: Epiphora (excess tearing) not resolved by conservative measures; or Corneal dryness unresponsive to lubricants; or Corneal ulcer

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: 'Internal Browpexy for any condition is considered cosmetic and not medically necessary.' Benefit Considerations lists cosmetic exclusion; psychological consequences do not make a procedure reconstructive.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Brow ptosis repair and repair of the eyelid are considered reconstructive and medically necessary in certain circumstances. For medical necessity clinical coverage criteria, refer to the InterQual CP: Procedures
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The criteria are not on the page; an automated checker given this PDF alone has nothing to evaluate for blepharoplasty.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Note: If multiple procedures are requested, criteria for each individual procedure must be met.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Says nothing about what 'met' means since criteria are external.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The InterQual criteria below only apply to persons 18 years of age or older.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'below' but nothing is below; refers to externally held criteria; no pathway stated for under 18.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Moderate to severe disease where all the following apply: ... or Severe, sight-threatening thyroid eye disease to address subluxation
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The bullet 'or' is on its own line between blocks, and 'euthyroidism has been achieved and maintained' is a state that can change.

requirement_kinds.quote: For medical necessity clinical coverage criteria, refer to the InterQual CP: Procedures: Blepharoplasty, Ectropion Repair, Entropion Repair, Eyelid Lesion Excision, Eyelid Reconstruction, Ptosis Repair
The InterQual criteria below only apply to persons 18 years of age or older
There is a functional impairment (e.g., dry eyes, pain/discomfort, tearing, blurred vision)
requirement_kinds.where: lid retraction; thyroid eye disease; canthoplasty

requirement_kinds.quote: Other causes have been eliminated as the reason for the lid retraction such as use of dilating eye drops or glaucoma medications
The disease is stable or inactive, and euthyroidism has been achieved and maintained
Clear, high-quality, clinical photographs ... Lids must be everted in the photographs; Conjunctival surface (underbelly) of the lids must be clearly visible
Eyelash ptosis; and Significant upper eyelid laxity ... giant papillary conjunctivitis or corneal findings
Documentation that conservative treatment has been tried and failed; examples may include: ocular lubricants ... antihistamines ... topical steroid drops ... eye shield
Infections of the eye have been ruled out
Internal Browpexy for any condition is considered cosmetic

thresholds.quote: The InterQual criteria below only apply to persons 18 years of age or older

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: CPT grouped by procedure heading; note: 'The following codes may be cosmetic; review is required to determine if considered cosmetic or reconstructive.' 67961 and 67966 appear twice (Canthoplasty and Floppy Eyelid Syndrome).

external_dependencies.what: InterQual CP: Procedures (Blepharoplasty, Ectropion, Entropion, Eyelid Lesion Excision, Eyelid Reconstruction, Ptosis Repair)
external_dependencies.quote: refer to the InterQual® CP: Procedures

external_dependencies.what: Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews
external_dependencies.quote: refer to the guidelines titled Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews

external_dependencies.what: State benefit mandates for cosmetic services
external_dependencies.quote: Some states require benefit coverage for services that UnitedHealthcare considers cosmetic procedures

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: The inability to close the eyelids completely.
A minimally invasive technique to provide stabilization and subtle elevation of the lateral brow

vague_terms.quote: complete closure to the eye, resulting in dryness and other complications

extraction_hazards: The central criteria are a hyperlink to InterQual, invisible to text extraction.
'Click here to view the InterQual criteria' link text only.
CPT table has 67961/67966 repeated under two headings.
Footers 'Proprietary Information of UnitedHealthcare' on each page; criteria bullets with 'or' on its own line between blocks.
Long Clinical Evidence section (pp.5-7) about floppy eyelid, lagophthalmos, lid retraction can be mistaken for criteria.
interesting_structures: Criteria delegated to a proprietary vendor tool; the policy itself is a router.
Policy-level carve-outs with detailed criteria exist only for rarer conditions.
Age gate (>= 18) attached to external tool.
Photograph standard defined for floppy eyelid syndrome (lids everted).

fit_to_tree.why: For the main blepharoplasty question, the criteria do not exist in the document; they live in InterQual. A checker can only evaluate the few written carve-outs.
